title: EATF Agent Evidence Package toolkit
description: Open toolkit for creating, inspecting, and offline-verifying Agent Evidence Packages (.aep): TypeScript and Python verifiers, sign/verify/inspect CLIs, JSON schemas, runnable examples, and positive/negative conformance vectors. Version 0.3.0 adds stable machine-readable first-failure codes, a fixed model-based oracle, and a deterministic 21-case decision-path corpus. The preserved confirmatory run records 21/21 oracle matches and 21/21 TypeScript/Python verdict-and-code matches across two accepting paths and 16 distinct rejection states.
notes: Version 0.4.0 adds two experiments: experiments/path-shadowing (a four-case demonstration, on shipped code, that a negative control can be correctly rejected by both implementations with identical codes and still never reach the state it was written to test; expected outcomes frozen before the run, 4/4 held) and experiments/jcs-boundary (the same discipline applied to two third-party RFC 8785 implementations, canonicalize 3.0.0 and rfc8785 0.1.4, where 5 of 10 boundary inputs return different outcomes). Prior version v0.3.0 is doi:10.5281/zenodo.21618887 under concept doi:10.5281/zenodo.21511608. Both new runners are offline and byte-deterministic across consecutive runs.
